subject.title: Workboard dispatch sub-agent missing workboard tools; card stuck at running status

question: Should plugin subagent.run grow a narrow runtime toolsAllow parameter for Workboard workers, or should Workboard solve this by changing tool optionality or lifecycle fallback behavior?
rationale: The bug is source-proven, but the durable fix crosses the plugin runtime and Gateway request contract, so maintainer intent is needed before implementation.

options.title: Add subagent toolsAllow
options.body: Extend the plugin subagent/Gateway path to forward an explicit allowlist, then have Workboard grant only its heartbeat, completion, block, proof, log, attachment, and release tools to dispatched workers.

options.title: Make Workboard tools default
options.body: Remove optional gating for some or all Workboard tools, accepting a broader default tool surface for normal sessions.

options.title: Use lifecycle fallback only
options.body: Block or recover cards when a worker exits without protocol tools, which reduces stuck cards but does not give workers the documented completion path.

recommendation.title: Add subagent toolsAllow
recommendation.body: Extend the plugin subagent/Gateway path to forward an explicit allowlist, then have Workboard grant only its heartbeat, completion, block, proof, log, attachment, and release tools to dispatched workers.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the Workboard dispatch feature and is the strongest feature-history owner for the intended dispatch/tool contract.
